stories.title: Dampier puts 9-0 Utah 'on his back' in 'big win' over BYU
stories.summary: In what was the first-ever Holy War matchup between BYU and Utah as top-10 teams, the game delivered a blockbuster that featured several big momentum swings and a QB in Devon Dampier at the center of it all who propelled the Utes to a 28-20 win.

stories.title: Manning, defense help No. 7 Horns rally late to trip Mizzou
stories.summary: In the wake of a 34-20 victory over Missouri on Saturday, Texas coach Steve Sarkisian lauded his Longhorns, who notched a fourth win over a top-20 opponent, telling reporters "I believe there's a toughness in our organization that is kind of undeniable."

stories.title: Interim HC Stockstill wins debut as Seminoles end almost 3-year road skid
stories.summary: Rick Stockstill won his first game as interim coach as Florida State ended an almost three-year drought on the road with a 31-24 victory at Boston College.

stories.title: Nashville breaks Miami's MLS single-season points record
stories.summary: Nashville set a new single-season MLS points record after reaching 77 points with its win over FC Cincinnati on the final day of the regular season.

stories.title: Sources: Colts engaged in Jones trade talks as multiple teams inquire about QB
stories.summary: The Colts have engaged in trade discussions with multiple teams involving quarterback Daniel Jones, sources told NFL Network and ESPN.
